<thought>Using the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 234.132 Da. Matching this mass to plausible organic formulas, the best fit is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass = 234.1256 Da, within typical MS tolerance). This formula also aligns with the observed ~16 % M+1 intensity, consistent with ~14–15 carbons. Therefore the molecular formula of the sample compound is C14H18O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
